gaps.sentence: He ___ her on her presentation and her handling of questions.
The city archive preserves ___ maps of the harbour from the 1700s.
gaps.explanation: 'Historical' describes things connected with the study of the past; 'historic' means momentous.

gaps.sentence: Thousands of people were forced to ___ their homes.
gaps.hint: a verb is needed after 'to'; meaning: abandon
gaps.explanation: 'Desert' is also a verb meaning to abandon; 'dessert' is only the sweet course of a meal.

gaps.sentence: The ___ repairs were making the theatre impossible to run profitably.
The bank agreed to ___ him the money.
gaps.hint: meaning: give temporarily (from the giver's point of view)
gaps.explanation: 'Lend' means to give something to someone temporarily; the bank lends money. A base verb is needed after 'to'.

gaps.sentence: Take my ___ and sell the car before the prices fall.
gaps.explanation: 'Take my advice' — the noun form follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't ___ what he was saying because of the noise.
gaps.explanation: 'Hear' means to receive sound; 'listen' means to pay attention deliberately and needs 'to'.

gaps.sentence: Should any dispute ___, the matter will go to arbitration.
gaps.explanation: 'Arise' = (problems, disputes) occur; 'rise' means go up and 'raise' needs an object.
